summary: Markets are cautiously constructive but remain range-bound: Bitcoin is holding near $83,000-$84,000 while weakening rebound momentum and the upcoming U.S. CPI create downside risk. Equities and gold are firmer as oil retreats, but altcoin sentiment is mixed despite strength in several Layer-2 tokens; the available sources do not verify same-day commentary from every requested analyst.
